jobs.title: Program Manager Operations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About us

Medline is a leading provider of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions, serving all points of care. Through a wide-ranging product portfolio, a robust supply chain network and modern clinical solutions, Medline helps healthcare providers (HCPs) improve their clinical, financial and operational outcomes. Headquartered in Northfield, Illinois, United States, the company employs more than 43,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries and territories. Outside the US, Medline EMEA headquarters is in Utrecht, the Netherlands.

To learn more about Medline’s operations in Europe, visit www.medline.eu.
Program Manager Operations (m/f/d)

To support the continued growth and development of our European operations network, we are looking for a Program Manager Operations (m/f/d) to join our Operations Programs & Partnerships team.

As a Program Manager, you will lead strategic operational programs and projects that enhance our warehousing, distribution, and service capabilities across Europe. Working closely with stakeholders from operations, business, and technology, you will drive successful project delivery, manage organizational change, and contribute to operational excellence throughout the organization.

Location: Germany (Kleve)

The opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Program Manager Operations (m/f/d) to lead strategic initiatives that support the growth and optimization of Medline’s European warehousing and service network. In this role, you will manage complex, cross-functional programs from concept through implementation, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in line with business objectives.

As a key liaison between operational and technical teams, you will drive change management initiatives, maintain business continuity throughout project execution, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our European operations network. This is an excellent opportunity for a results-driven professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment and enjoys turning strategy into action.

Your responsibilities
- Lead and manage strategic operations programs that support the development and optimization of Medline’s warehousing and service landscape across Europe.
- Oversee the successful delivery of multiple projects, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and business objectives.
- Own program planning, resource allocation, budgeting, governance, risk management, and stakeholder communication throughout the project lifecycle.
- Develop and maintain compelling business cases, including financial analyses and ROI assessments, while tracking benefits realization throughout program execution.
- Identify opportunities to improve business processes and successfully guide teams through organizational change.
- Provide hands-on support to local sites and project teams to facilitate implementation and ensure rapid issue resolution.
- Establish clear communication frameworks to keep stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned at every stage of the program.
- Coach and support project teams on project management methodologies, tools, and milestones, fostering a structured and results-oriented approach.
- Organize and facilitate internal and external project meetings, workshops, and governance forums.
- Define, monitor, and report on program and project KPIs to drive performance and ensure successful outcomes.
- Proactively manage project risks and issues, implementing mitigating actions where required.
- Collaborate closely with Medline’s Project Management Office (PMO) to ensure projects are executed in accordance with established standards, methodologies, and best practices.

Are you our match?
Required qualifications:
- 10+ years of experience in warehousing, distribution, supply chain, or operations management.
- Proven success in program and project management within international and cross-functional environments.
- Experience leading large-scale operational change initiatives in a fast-paced business setting.
- Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and engage teams at all levels of the organization.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
- A hands-on, proactive mindset with the ability to drive initiatives from concept to completion.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- High level of autonomy, rigor, and attention to detail.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience interacting with senior leadership.
- Fluent in English and German as a plus.

We have everything covered:
- Modern IT Environment : Work with up‑to‑date tools, technologies, and high‑performance hardware to build reliable and innovative solutions.
- Hybrid Work Options: Benefit from a flexible setup that combines remote work with on‑site collaboration.
- Learning & Certifications : Access to training platforms, professional certifications, conferences, and continuous learning opportunities within the IT field.
- Meaningful Digital Projects: Contribute to impactful technology initiatives that directly support and improve healthcare operations across Europe.
- Strong IT Community: Collaborate within an international team that values knowledge‑sharing, mentoring, and cross‑functional teamwork.
- Competitive Compensation Package: Market‑aligned salary, performance‑based bonus opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package.
- Wellbeing & Work‑Life Balance: Wellness resources, employee assistance support, and a generous paid‑time‑off offering.

Why Medline
Medline is one of the largest providers of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions serving all points of care. Through its broad product portfolio, resilient supply chain, and leading clinical solutions, Medline helps healthcare providers improve their clinical, financial, and operational outcomes.
Headquartered in the United States, Medline employs more than 45,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries and territories.
In EMEA, we partner with healthcare providers to deliver clinically focused products and services built on four foundations: tradition, proximity to clients, reliability, and sustainability.
By combining global scale with local insight, and building on its foundation of tradition, proximity to clients, reliability, and sustainability, Medline helps healthcare run better — enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.
To learn more about how Medline makes healthcare run better, visit www.medline.eu .

Ready to shape the future of our European operations network?
Apply now and join our Operations Programs & Partnerships team, make an impact, and help drive strategic initiatives that enhance operational excellence across Europe. For questions, reach out to Beate Aschoff, beate.aschoff@medline.com

#LI-EU
What we offer

• Market related salary and a bonus plan
• A range of training opportunities
• Employee Assistance Program
• Hybrid working options
• International working environment

Ready for a new challenge?

At Medline, we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential for achieving success and fostering innovation. We are committed to promoting an inclusive work environment where everyone is valued and respected for their unique differences. Through our selection processes, we are dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities and fairness for all candidates, regardless of their background, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or any other personal characteristic.

Medline is committed to reducing our carbon footprint, developing responsible products, supporting our employees and local communities, and promoting high ethical standards internally and among our supplier partners. Medline has an immediate opening for a Manager of Business Operations supporting our Textiles & Environmental Services divisions! This position will be based out of our Northfield, IL headquarters and will work on a hybrid model. The Manager of Business Operations is responsible for leading and managing a team of operations analysts and a team of operations specialists to deliver data-driven insights that support the organization’s strategic objectives. Business operations to include: inventory management, division analytics, forecast/demand planning, allocation management, and process improvement. This role involves working closely with leadership to inform decision-making, optimize business performance, and drive operational strategies and continuous process improvement. The Manager of Business Operations plays a crucial role in guiding the business operations analytics team and the operations specialist team to success while fostering a culture of excellence and ensuring the delivery of high-quality analytical support to various departments.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Lead - FP&A for the Reporting function supporting Medline Europe (EMEA), with additional support to international teams as required. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing recurring reporting activities, coordinating reporting transitions, and ensuring timely and accurate delivery of financial reports, dashboards, and management reporting requirements while mentoring a small team of analysts.
This role is focused on reporting operations, governance, process improvements, and stakeholder coordination within a shared services/GCC environment.
Responsibilities:
1. Team Leadership:
- Manage and develop a team of analysts, guiding their growth and ensuring delivery of high-quality work.
- Allocate and monitor team deliverables to ensure timely completion of reporting activities.
- Set clear objectives for the team, provide regular feedback, and support capability development.
- Conduct performance reviews and support team engagement and collaboration.
- Serve as backup for the reporting manager and support other team members when required.

2. Financial Reporting:
- Ensure timely and accurate preparation of recurring financial reports including monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting deliverables.
- Oversee preparation of CFO decks, flash reports, dashboards, KPI trackers, and management reporting packs.
- Review reporting deliverables prepared by team members to ensure quality, accuracy, and adherence to reporting standards before sharing with onshore stakeholders.
- Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end reporting activities.
- Support management reporting and GAAP reporting activities through Oracle PBCS /EPBCS and related reporting systems.
- Ensure consistency, completeness, and governance of financial data across reports and systems.

3. Reporting Support & Coordination:
- Work closely with onshore stakeholders to support recurring reporting requirements and reporting timelines.
- Support transition of reporting activities from onshore or other teams into the GCC/shared services environment.
- Coordinate with cross-functional teams for reporting inputs, issue resolution, and timely closure of deliverables.
- Maintain reporting documentation, SOPs, trackers, and process notes.

4. Process Improvement:
- Continuously evaluate and improve reporting processes to enhance efficiency, standardization, and accuracy.
- Identify opportunities for automation and simplification using reporting and analytics tools.
Support implementation of process improvements and reporting enhancements.

5. Stakeholder Management:
- Develop and maintain effective relationships with onshore and offshore stakeholders.
- Understand reporting requirements, manage expectations, address operational concerns, and escalate issues as required.
- Ensure effective communication and coordination across teams and geographies.

6. Ad Hoc Reporting Support:
- Support ad-hoc reporting requests, data requirements, and operational analysis from stakeholders.
- Respond to queries from onshore business partners in an accurate and timely manner.

Skills and Experience:
- Experience working cross-functionally and collaboratively in a global organization.
- At least 2 years of experience managing a team.
- 7–10 years of experience in financial reporting, finance operations, or reporting support roles.
- Experience in shared services/GCC environment preferred.
- Strong technical accounting skills and practical understanding of accounting principles and reporting processes.
- Strong skills in MS Office applications including advanced Excel and PowerPoint.
- Advanced skill level in Microsoft Excel including Power Query and Power Pivot.
- Experience working with ERP systems, preferably QAD.
- Hands-on experience or working knowledge of Oracle PBCS / EPBCS.
- Exposure to Power BI, Alteryx, dashboards, and reporting automation tools preferred.
Strong analytical, organizational, and coordination skills.
- Continuous improvement mindset with focus on process efficiency and reporting governance.
- Flexible and collaborative team player.

Educational Qualifications:
- CA/CMA or MBA from a reputed institute.
- 7–10 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
- Hands-on experience with Oracle PBCS / ERP systems / Power BI / reporting tools preferred.

jobs.title: The Director of Sales – Walmart & Sam’s
jobs.description:
Job Summary
The Director of Sales – Walmart & Sam’s is the senior commercial leader responsible for Medline’s strategic relationship and growth agenda with these customers. This leader owns customer strategy, profitable growth, annual and long-term business planning, executive relationships, and cross-functional execution across the customer ecosystem.

The role translates customer, financial, market, and operational insights into clear priorities that expand the portfolio, strengthen the partnership, and deliver sustainable business results. The successful leader will be based in the Bentonville, Arkansas area and will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, eCommerce, and other functions to deliver customer commitments and growth opportunities.
Job Description
Responsibilities:

Customer Strategy & Business Ownership

- Develop and execute the long-term customer strategy for Walmart and Sam’s Club, aligning priorities to Medline’s broader Retail strategy and growth objectives.
- Own the annual and multi-year business planning process, including growth priorities, portfolio expansion, customer initiatives, risks, investments, and measures of success.
- Lead Joint Business Planning and other customer planning forums, translating strategy into clear commitments, owners, milestones, and operating rhythms.
- Drive profitable revenue growth by identifying opportunities across products, categories, channels, and customer programs while balancing customer needs, margin, service, and execution feasibility.
- Monitor customer, financial, market, and competitive performance; use insights to adjust priorities and recommend actions to senior leadership.

Customer Leadership & Influence

- Serve as the senior day-to-day commercial leader for Walmart and Sam’s Club and build trusted relationships with key customer decision-makers and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Lead strategic customer conversations, business reviews, negotiations, issue resolution, and growth initiatives with a clear understanding of each customer’s priorities and operating model.
- Represent Medline with credibility and sound judgment in high-stakes discussions, balancing partnership, commercial objectives, and long-term value creation.
- Maintain strong customer proximity in Northwest Arkansas and ensure timely visibility to changes in customer strategy, expectations, opportunities, and risks.

Cross-Functional Execution

- Align Sales, Marketing, Product, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, eCommerce, and other partners around customer priorities, tradeoffs, decisions, and execution plans.
- Create accountability for delivery of customer commitments, product launches, portfolio expansion, service improvements, and other strategic initiatives.
- Anticipate and resolve complex business issues; establish clear escalation paths and mobilize the right leaders and resources when decisions or intervention are required.
- Partner with internal teams to evaluate customer requests, investments, and solutions using financial, operational, and customer impact.

People Leadership & Management Responsibilities

- Hire, lead, coach, and develop the Walmart and Sam’s Club sales team, setting clear expectations and creating accountability for individual and business results.
- Build team capability in strategic account management, customer influence, analytics, negotiation, problem solving, and cross-functional leadership.
- Assess organizational needs and make recommendations regarding compensation, training & development, structure, talent, performance management, succession planning, and resources required to support the business.
- Foster an inclusive, high-performance culture grounded in collaboration, urgency, resilience, and strong business judgment.

Minimum Job Requirements

Education
Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, finance, supply chain, sales, or a related field.

Work Experience
- 8-12 years of progressive experience in sales, national accounts, customer development, retail, or a related commercial function. Direct experience managing Walmart and/or Sam’s Club business.
- Experience leading both private-label and branded product strategies within a large retail account.
- At least 5 years of experience leading and developing sales professionals, including responsibility for hiring, performance, development, and work direction.
- Demonstrated experience managing a large, complex book of business with meaningful revenue responsibility, a broad product portfolio, and numerous customer stakeholders and points of contact.
- Strong financial acumen and experience developing annual business plans, leading customer negotiations, evaluating business performance and investments, and presenting recommendations to senior executives.
- Demonstrated success implementing strategic initiatives through cross-functional leadership and influence.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
- Deep understanding of large-scale retail account management, customer planning, commercial strategy, and the operational dependencies required to deliver results.
- Strong financial and analytical acumen, including the ability to assess revenue, margin, investment, forecast, performance trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
- Ability to convert complex information into a focused strategy, clear priorities, and disciplined execution plans.
- Proven ability to influence senior customer and internal stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority.
- Exceptional negotiation, communication, executive Prescence, and business review capabilities.
- Demonstrated judgement and resilience when navigating ambiguity, competing priorities, customer pressure, and high-visibility issues.
- Ability to lead across functions and create shared accountability for customer commitments and business outcomes.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and data-driven business reporting
- Must reside in or relocate to the Bentonville, Arkansas area; ability to travel based on customer and business needs.

Preferred Job Requirements

Education
Master’s degree business administration, marketing, finance, supply chain, sales, or a related field.

Work Experience

- Experience leading Walmart and/or Sam’s Club business for a manufacturer or supplier with comparable scale, portfolio breadth, and customer complexity.
- Established knowledge of Walmart and Sam’s Club planning cycles, stakeholder networks, customer expectations, and ways of working.
- Experience leading Joint Business Planning, category or portfolio growth strategies, and executive-level customer presentations.
- Experience using retailer data and insights platforms, customer scorecards, and market intelligence to guide decisions and identify growth opportunities.
- Experience across both in-store and eCommerce/omnichannel customer strategies.

Medline has an opening for a Sr Director, Business Operations supporting Medline's brand product divisions! This position will be based out of our Northfield, IL headquarters and will offer a hybrid model of work.

The Sr Director, Business Operations will provide enterprise level oversight for multiple business operations teams supporting Medline brand product divisions. This person will lead divisional analytics including operating expense management, expense forecasting, and KPI management, while overseeing operational capabilities such as inventory management, demand planning, allocation, and process improvement.

The Sr Director will also define and execute long term business and operational strategies that enable scale, efficiency, and sustained financial performance. Proactively align resources, capabilities, and execution to evolving business needs and enterprise objectives.

- Own the global service delivery model for the overseas support team in Pune, India, including operating strategy, talent development, performance management, and continuous improvement. Ensure teams deliver high‑quality support for product management and cross functional teams while increasing output, accuracy, and scalability.

- Translate enterprise and functional leadership strategy into actionable operating models, objectives, and performance metrics that drive execution and accountability across teams.
- Management responsibilities include: - Leads through multiple layers of management, developing leaders and ensuring consistent execution across teams and geographies.
- Provides senior leadership to major departments or functions with broad operational or enterprise‑wide accountability.
- Accountable for strategic, tactical, and operational planning with a forward‑looking horizon (12+ months), balancing near‑term delivery with long‑term capability building.
- Holds direct budget responsibility for multiple departments, functions, or large programs, ensuring financial discipline and return on investment.
- Interprets, implements, and influences organizational policies; develops and recommends new policies or governance enhancements to support evolving business needs.
- Oversees workforce strategy including senior hiring, compensation recommendations, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development to ensure a strong and scalable talent pipeline.
